ValidationRule.description: Additional fields are required if SI is marked as definite.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Systemic_Issue', ISPICKVAL(SI_Definite__c, '1'), OR( ISBLANK(IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c), ISBLANK(SI_Definite_Action_Required__c), ISBLANK(SI_Definite_First_Identified_Date__c), ISBLANK(SI_Definite_Deemed_Date__c), ISBLANK(SI_Definite_Action_Completed__c), ISBLANK(SI_Definite_Action_Completed_Date__c), ISBLANK(SI_Definite_Conduct_Start_Date__c), ISBLANK(SI_Definite_Conduct_End_Date__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All fields in the Definite systemic Issue Information section are mandatory if issue is marked as definite.
